title: Robot Intelligence
tagline: How robots find their way, plan, talk and stay safe.
description: How robots map, plan, talk, learn and stay safe, then design your own. Ten simple story lessons.
outcome: After this course you can explain how a robot maps a space, plans a route, understands people and stays safe.
whoFor: Learners who finished the earlier courses and want to understand how robots find their way, plan, talk and stay safe.
outcomes: Explain how a robot builds and uses a map
Explain how a robot finds its own position
Describe how a robot plans a safe route and handles surprises
Explain how speech becomes action, and how robots learn from practice
Apply basic safety, teamwork and design steps to your own robot idea

finalActivity.title: Design your own robot on paper
finalActivity.prompt: Design your own robot on paper: write its job in one sentence, list its parts (what it senses, decides and does), and describe a first small test.

lessons.title: Maps: how a robot remembers a place
lessons.summary: Explain what a map is to a robot.

quiz.q: What is a map to a robot?
options: A stored picture of where things are
quiz.why: A map records where walls and objects are.

quiz.q: Why does a robot need a map?
A simple robot map can be…
options: A grid showing free and blocked squares
quiz.why: Grid maps mark blocked and free cells.

quiz.q: When a new object appears, the map should…
quiz.why: Maps must change with the world.

lessons.title: Where am I?
lessons.summary: Explain localisation: working out where the robot is on a map.

quiz.q: Localisation means…
options: Working out where the robot is on its map

quiz.q: Counting wheel turns can estimate position but…
options: Small errors add up over time

quiz.q: How can a robot correct its drift?
options: Compare what it sees with the map

quiz.q: A landmark is…
options: Something easy to recognise that stays in place

lessons.title: Planning a route
lessons.summary: Describe how a robot finds a path from A to B.

quiz.q: Route planning finds…
options: A path from start to goal
quiz.why: It searches for a way from A to B.

quiz.q: A good route usually…
quiz.why: Planners avoid obstacles and prefer short paths.

quiz.q: If the direct path is blocked, the planner should…
Planning on a map works best when the map is…
quiz.why: A wrong map gives a wrong plan.

lessons.title: Dodging the unexpected
lessons.summary: Handle moving obstacles while following a plan.

quiz.q: A person steps into the robot's path. It should…
options: Slow or stop and avoid them

quiz.q: Why keep sensing while following a plan?
After dodging, the robot should…
options: Return to its plan or make a new one
quiz.why: It should get back on route.

quiz.q: Planning ahead and reacting quickly are both needed because…
options: Plans guide, reactions keep you safe
quiz.why: Both help reach the goal safely.

lessons.title: Talking to robots
lessons.summary: Explain how a robot can understand spoken instructions.

quiz.q: The first step in understanding speech is…
quiz.why: Speech recognition makes text from audio.

quiz.q: After the words are known, the robot must…
options: Work out what action is meant

quiz.q: Why can speech commands be misunderstood?
options: Noise and different ways of speaking

quiz.q: A safe robot should…
Trial and reward learning means…
options: Try, see the result, do better next time

quiz.q: A reward tells the robot…
Why do mistakes help learning?
Learning in a simulator first is useful because…
options: Mistakes there are safe and cheap
It is the same as real life

lessons.title: Safe robots
lessons.summary: List safety ideas for robots near people.

quiz.q: A basic safety feature is…
quiz.why: An emergency stop halts the robot at once.

quiz.q: Robots near people should…
Why test safety features regularly?
quiz.why: Safety must be checked, not assumed.

quiz.q: If a sensor fails, a safe robot should…
options: Stop or enter a safe mode

lessons.title: Robots in teams
lessons.summary: Describe how several robots can share a job.

quiz.q: Why use several robots for one job?
options: They can finish faster by sharing work

quiz.q: Robots in a team must…
options: Share information so they don't clash

quiz.q: Splitting a job means…
If one robot fails, a good team…

lessons.title: Design your own robot
lessons.summary: Use a simple process to plan a robot for a real need.

quiz.q: A good design starts with…
quiz.why: Start with the problem to solve.

quiz.q: Writing the job in one sentence helps because…
quiz.why: A clear sentence prevents wandering ideas.

quiz.q: After the job, you list…
options: Parts the robot needs to sense, decide and act
quiz.why: Choose sensors, a brain and actuators.

lessons.title: Your robotics future
lessons.summary: Plan next steps for learning and careers in robotics.

quiz.q: A good next learning step is to…
Which skills help in robotics?
options: Curiosity, building, simple coding and maths

quiz.q: How can you keep learning?
options: Try projects and keep a notebook of what you learn

quiz.q: Careers in robotics include…
options: Building, programming, testing and designing robots
